subject.title: fix(agents): pass attemptNumber instead of apiKeyIndex to retry callbacks (#102938)

question: Should the shipped `attempt` callback field enter a formal deprecation lifecycle in this PR, or remain supported without a deprecation marker while the explicit fields are added?
rationale: The new fields mechanically fix the ambiguity, but declaring a public plugin SDK field deprecated establishes future API direction that source correctness alone cannot authorize.

options.title: Keep `attempt` supported
options.body: Remove `@deprecated`, land the additive fields, and leave any future retirement to a separately approved compatibility plan.

options.title: Approve formal deprecation
options.body: Retain the marker only with owner approval, public migration guidance, compatibility coverage, and a named removal timeline.

recommendation.title: Keep `attempt` supported
recommendation.body: Remove `@deprecated`, land the additive fields, and leave any future retirement to a separately approved compatibility plan.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the merged same-key retry semantics most directly responsible for the callback distinction and is the strongest recent area-history candidate.
